# Habibi Ahmad Aziz

> Habibi Ahmad Aziz is a Fullstack Developer from Karawang, Indonesia. He ships production web apps with Next.js, React, Laravel, and WordPress.

Habibi Ahmad Aziz (also known as Habibi Ahmad / habibiahmada) is a Fullstack Developer based in Karawang, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. He graduated from SMKN 1 Karawang in Software Engineering (RPL), works as a Web Developer at PT Webekspres Teknologi Indonesia, and is open to freelance and full-time remote roles (WIB).

Notable proof points:
- E-Vote / E-Democracy in production at SMKN 1 Karawang
- Indonesia country award at Intel AI Global Impact Festival 2025 (Agrify / Smartfarm AI, team)
- Coding Camp (DBS Foundation) Top 15 capstone with CultureConnect
- Dicoding public story on Coding Camp and shipping under pressure
